acceptance: With a live loop and stage on, pr merge merges a docs-only green PR and refuses a go/ PR with the live-loop reason (red test first)
At stage off, pr merge refuses every PR while a loop is live, as today
The early-boundary rule names the waiting PR, its wait and the pool width in one line, and it reads its bound from policy
fix: TDD first (red test before code), 100% coverage on new and changed functions, zero comments, the package note and the spec updated.
routed_reason: gated on fleet.integration.stage=enforce (ADR-0147) and the operator stage flip pr.merge_window.stage; changes the console-owned merge control of evolve pr merge
summary: Component P2b of plan pr-merge-latency-2026-10 (D3, D4). Gated on fleet.integration.stage=enforce (ADR-0147, wave-integration D15; P1 is shelved) and on pr.merge_window.stage=on. (1) evolve pr merge admits a PR while a loop is live only when evolve pr window says window; a boundary PR keeps the live-loop refusal. (2) The console calls an early boundary (evolve loop-stop --wait, then wave next --merge) when a green boundary PR has waited more than the policy bound and the pool runs below its window. Evidence: green PRs waited 61 PR-hours for a boundary over #979-#1005 (median 1.2 h, max 9.6 h).
title: PR merge latency P2b: pr merge takes window PRs mid-wave, and the console calls an early boundary
